title: Thermodynamic profiles for co-translational trigger factor function
authors: Herling TW; Cassaignau AME; Wentink AS; Peter QAE; Kumar PC; Kartanas T; Schneider MM; Cabrita LD; Christodoulou J; Knowles TPJ
one_liner_zh: 该文研究分子伴侣trigger factor与核糖体及新生链的热力学结合，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA体系，与课题无关。
abstract: Molecular chaperones are central to the maintenance of proteostasis in living cells. A key member of this protein family is trigger factor (TF), which acts throughout the protein lifecycle and has a ubiquitous role as the first chaperone encountered by proteins during synthesis. However, our understanding of how TF achieves favourable interactions with such a diverse substrate base remains limited. Here, we use microfluidics to reveal the thermodynamic determinants of this process. We find that TF binding to empty 70S ribosomes is enthalpydriven, with micromolar affinity, while nanomolar affinity is achieved through a favourable entropic contribution for both intrinsically disordered and folding competent nascent chains. These findings suggest a general mechanism for co-translational TF function, which relies on occupation of the exposed TF substrate-binding groove, rather than specific complementarity between chaperone and RNC. These insights add to our wider understanding of how proteins can achieve broad substrate specificity.
abstract_zh: 分子伴侣对于活细胞中蛋白质稳态的维持至关重要。该蛋白家族中的一个关键成员是触发因子（trigger factor, TF），它在蛋白质生命周期中发挥作用，并作为蛋白质合成过程中首先遇到的伴侣，具有普遍性的角色。然而，我们对TF如何与如此多样化的底物基础实现有利相互作用的理解仍然有限。在此，我们利用微流控技术揭示了这一过程的热力学决定因素。我们发现，TF与空载70S核糖体的结合是由焓驱动的，具有微摩尔级亲和力，而对于内在无序和折叠胜任的新生链，则通过有利的熵贡献实现纳摩尔级亲和力。这些发现提示了共翻译TF功能的一般机制，该机制依赖于暴露的TF底物结合沟槽的占据，而非伴侣与核糖体-新生链复合物（RNC）之间的特异性互补。这些见解增进了我们对蛋白质如何实现广泛底物特异性的更全面理解。
